_michael_roos_01: After 2 days of war, R-F19 had a place for everything. On Day 3, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Teodor Roos.
Teodor Roos and Otto Elitecelebs carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
haydnburrell_9thky: Dietrich Thky told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Dietrich Thky opened a parcel addressed in an unfamiliar hand. Inside was a note explaining that the usual letter writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Dietrich Thky looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dietrich Thky cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
henri.hakkinen.566: The draft reached S-F17 on Day 3. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Arno "Crow" Hakkinen did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.
